purpose: Fast windowed PBT with cool-down probes, the final LR decay of standard ParT (last 15 of 50 generations, x0.01) and the LR range of standard ParT on train8m including the 3e-3 run (start LRs 3e-5 to 3e-3, max_lr 3e-3): sel1m_train8m_fast_pbt_probe_decay, seed 12345, selected on sel1m_tail. Fixed before training, after the sel1m_tail curves (not the holdout) of sel1m_train8m_fast_pbt_probe and sel1m_train8m_standard_part_3e-3. A development run: this seed and training set have already been used for three PBT variants. References: standard ParT with start LR 1e-3 and 3e-3, and probe PBT without decay. Primary comparison: this run against the standard ParT checkpoint (1e-3 or 3e-3) with the better sel1m_tail value; the holdout does not choose. Secondary: this run against probe PBT without decay.
